# AAA — AI Agents Agency

> AAA builds AI agents that do real work in small and medium businesses: answering customers, taking orders, reading invoices. When a business needs more than one agent, AAA builds the whole system. Every system listed below is already running in a real business, not a demo.

## What AAA builds

AAA designs and ships AI agents and automation systems for SMBs — customer-facing agents (WhatsApp, voice), back-office automation (invoice reading, order-to-production pipelines), and compliance/decision engines. Engagements start with a free scoping call; pricing is a fixed-price proposal scoped to what actually needs building, not a subscription.

## Case studies

- [Cashflow](https://gocashflow.co/) — pulls supplier invoices from Gmail, Drive, WhatsApp and Green Invoice, reads them with OCR, catches duplicates, and gathers everything onto a single cash-flow board. Live product, try it directly.
- [Floory](https://floory.urbanbakery.co/) — order and inventory platform for bakeries. Client orders (portal or WhatsApp) go straight to the production list, then packing, then history. Running at Urban Bakery every morning; 320+ orders/week, under 3 seconds from order to production.
- Food Label Engine — feed it a recipe, get a print-ready nutrition/allergen label checked against Israeli Ministry of Health thresholds, deciding on its own which warning labels are required. 13/13 products fully compliant at Urban Bakery.
- WhatsApp agent — answers customers inside a business's own WhatsApp in whatever language they wrote in (Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian), 24/7, in under 5 seconds, and knows when to hand off to a human.
- Jarvis — a voice AI assistant sitting on a studio's accumulated knowledge and IP: ask out loud, get an answer with its sources. Includes a deal-filtering engine for the luxury/hospitality space.
